excerpt_en: Fighter, wife of Aghbyur Serob, and one of the movement's most remembered women.
content_en: Fighter, wife of Aghbyur Serob, and one of the movement's most remembered women. Sose fought alongside her husband and, after his death, continued to lead in the mountains herself. Her letters and the accounts of those who served with her give one of the fullest pictures we have of the women who shaped the fedayi era, not as footnotes but as commanders in their own right.
